svg.text: text, PDF, DOCX, MD, TXT, images
Images: read by a vision LLM
scripts are optional: skip straight to the report
scenario edited later → "test cases may be out of date"
problems found → retry with the issues (max 3 attempts, then alert the tester)
still failing after 3 attempts → tester is alerted to edit manually
Every run is saved with its token usage (draft history / restore, and the basis for monthly usage & plans). Deleted items stay in Recently deleted for 7 days.
Fig. 2. Planned pipeline of the AI Test Case Generator (future version): requirement → scenarios → test cases & execution → test scripts → report
